objectives.en: Change a fraction to a decimal and to a percentage.
objectives.yo: Yí fraction padà sí decimal àti sí percentage.
objectives.pcm: Change fraction to decimal and to percentage.

objectives.en: Change a percentage back to the fraction it came from.
objectives.yo: Yí percentage padà sí fraction tí ó ti wá.
objectives.pcm: Change percentage back to the fraction wey e come from.

curriculum.objective: Change fraction to decimal to percentage and back

say.en: You buy one hundred naira airtime. The bonus is fifty percent. That is one half, so fifty naira more.
say.pcm: You buy one hundred naira airtime. Network give fifty percent bonus. Fifty percent mean one half, so the bonus na another fifty naira airtime.
say.yo: O ra airtime naira one hundred. O gba bonus fifty percent. Ó jẹ́ naira fifty sí i.

say.en: Today you will change fractions into decimals and percentages.
say.pcm: Today you go fit change fractions to decimals and percentages.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò yí fractions padà sí decimals àti percentages.

say.en: Do you remember halves? What is half of one hundred naira?
say.pcm: You remember halves? Wetin be half of one hundred naira?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí ìdajì? Kí ni ìdajì naira one hundred?

say.en: One half is nought point five. Multiply by one hundred and it is fifty percent. One quarter is twenty-five percent.
say.pcm: One half na nought point five. One half na fifty percent. One quarter na nought point two five. One quarter na twenty-five percent.
say.yo: Ìdajì jẹ́ nought point five. Ìdajì jẹ́ fifty percent. Ìdámẹ́rin jẹ́ nought point two five. Ìdámẹ́rin jẹ́ twenty-five percent.

say.en: Together now. One tenth is one part in ten: nought point one. Say one half as a decimal.
say.pcm: Make we do am together. One tenth na one part for ten: nought point one. Talk one half as decimal.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká ṣiṣẹ́ papọ̀. Ìdámẹ́wàá jẹ́ apá kan nínú mẹ́wàá. Sọ ìdajì ní decimal.

say.en: Your turn alone. Say three quarters as a percentage.
say.pcm: Na your turn alone. Say three quarters as percentage.
say.yo: Ìwọ nìkan báyìí. Sọ ìdámẹ́rin mẹ́ta ní percentage.

say.en: If you missed it, remember one quarter is twenty-five percent. Three quarters is three lots of twenty-five percent.
say.pcm: Make we fix am together. One quarter na twenty-five percent. Three quarters na three lots of twenty-five percent.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún ṣe é papọ̀. Ìdámẹ́rin jẹ́ twenty-five percent. Ìdámẹ́rin mẹ́ta jẹ́ three lots of twenty-five percent.

say.en: Let us see what you remember. Say one tenth as a percentage.
say.pcm: Make we see wetin you remember. Say one tenth as percentage.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká wo ohun tí o rántí. Sọ ìdámẹ́wàá ní percentage.

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we change fractions again. Soon we learn squares and square roots.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go change fractions again. Soon we learn squares and square roots.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún yí fractions padà. Láìpẹ́ a ó kọ́ squares àti square roots.
